/work/ember.title: Ember — UEYON
/work/ember.description: Ember: a case study by UEYON — brand, digital and art direction for Marco Lindqvist.
p: Ember, an independent fashion house, was preparing its autumn collection and wanted a campaign that captured movement, warmth and energy.The challenge was to make a small release feel like a cultural moment across social, web and print.

We shaped a campaign around motion-blurred photography and a warm orange palette.A custom launch site and short-form video series carried the story across every channel.The collection sold out its first drop within two weeks.

/work/halo.title: Halo — UEYON
/work/halo.description: Halo: a case study by UEYON — brand, digital and art direction for Sofia Moreau.
p: Halo is a skincare brand rooted in calm rituals. Their previous identity felt clinical and failed to reflect the softness of the products.They asked us to build a gentler, dreamlike visual world that still felt premium and trustworthy.

We built a pastel identity system with airy typography and soft, luminous photography.The new editorial guidelines give the in-house team a clear and flexible toolkit.Halo now presents a cohesive story from packaging to social feeds.

/work/aura.title: Aura — UEYON
/work/aura.description: Aura: a case study by UEYON — brand, digital and art direction for James smith.
p: AURA needed a fresh and distinctive brand identity that could balance premium aesthetics with a warm, modern personality. The goal was to create a visual language that feels elegant, approachable, and consistent across every touchpoint.We focused on developing a strong foundation that could support the brand’s growth across both digital and physical experiences.

We created a refined visual identity and seamless digital experience that gives AURA a confident and memorable presence.From typography and visual direction to the website experience.The result is a modern lifestyle brand that connects naturally with its audience and stands out in a competitive market.

/work/nova.title: Nova — UEYON
/work/nova.description: Nova: a case study by UEYON — brand, digital and art direction for Elena Park.
p: Nova is a beauty label built around bold colour and self-expression. They needed a digital home that felt as vivid as their products while staying easy to shop.We set out to design a site that puts the campaign imagery first and lets the brand’s personality lead every interaction.

We delivered an editorial e-commerce experience with a striking red and teal art direction.Every product story is framed like a magazine spread.Since launch, Nova has seen longer sessions and a clear lift in online sales.
